There are 60 minutes in an hour.

Regarding the competitor analysis: Streamline Autos' direct-to-consumer (DTC) model presents a significant strategic challenge. By eliminating dealership markups, they can undercut traditional pricing, which may pressure our margins or force us to reconsider our value proposition. Furthermore, their direct engagement allows for real-time data collection on consumer preferences, enabling faster product iterations and more targeted marketing. To mitigate this, we should evaluate enhancing our own digital sales channels, emphasizing superior after-sales service or financing options that DTC models often struggle to match, and leveraging our existing dealership network for localized customer trust and immediate vehicle availability.
